newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro RSCG chosen for France Telecom campaign.
newsitem.headline: Euro RSCG chosen for France Telecom campaign.

text.p: France Telecom and the ministry of finance retained the advertising company Euro RSCG to run the financial promotional campaign for the partial privatisation of the state telephone utility, France Telecom said on Tuesday.
"This agency will go with France Telecom for its presentation to the financial community and for the necessary financial communication to ensure the success of the operation," France Telecom said.
The government has said it plans to offer a first tranche of 20 percent of France Telecom's capital in the second half of April and eventually sell up to 49 percent.
